body: ATTACK pairing conflict: security lane says QR must contain no bearer credential and requires authenticated new device + SAS + existing-console approval; remote lane proposes 256-bit fragment secret, one-use <=120s, SAS/display approval conditionally. Decide the smallest safe flow for the user's primary mirror case where presenter scans a QR from a private setup console. Address whether account login is mandatory and whether fragment secret is acceptable evidence-wise.
